class_prompts.vine_plant: cultivated grapevine plant in a vineyard row, including woody grapevine trunk, cordon, canes, stems, and attached grape leaves; exclude trees, hedges, bushes, wall vegetation, ornamental plants, grass, and wooden posts
class_prompts.vine_leaf: lobed green grapevine leaves attached to vineyard-row grapevines; exclude tree leaves, hedge leaves, bushes, grass, wall vegetation, and ornamental plants
class_prompts.vine_trunk: woody grapevine trunk, cordon, cane, and brown grapevine branches attached to a grapevine; exclude wooden vineyard posts, stakes, tree trunks, and stone walls
class_prompts.wooden_post: vertical wooden vineyard support post or stake, weathered wood, not grapevine trunk
class_prompts.ground: bare soil ground in a vineyard
class_prompts.tree: large tree canopy or tree trunk in the background, not grapevine
class_prompts.shrub_or_other_vegetation: shrub, bush, weed, grass, or other vegetation that is not grapevine
class_prompts.hedge_or_wall_vegetation: hedge, wall vegetation, ornamental garden plant, or dense background bush that is not a vineyard-row grapevine
